verdict.rationale: Synctera's docs describe an API-driven verification solution that runs identity and watchlist checks for both personal (KYC) and business (KYB) customers and records results as `verification` objects. Customers can be modeled as `PROSPECT` and later activated, sandbox test cases demonstrate multiple KYC/KYB flows, and a published OpenAPI spec supports programmatic integration. Missing for 10: document collection is only a thin one-line mention ('Verify documentation for a customer'), the full application/verification state machine is not shown beyond PROSPECT→activate, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
